category: Primary Function Involves Spinning or Rotation
explanation: Top, Wheel, Propeller, and Blender all have a primary function that involves continuous or repetitive spinning or rotational motion. A Lever's primary function is to multiply force by pivoting on a fulcrum, not continuous rotation.

category: The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: All tokens are part of the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, but the Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one that still largely stands today. The other four have been destroyed over time.

Sunlight, Starlight, Moonlight, and Daylight all refer to natural forms of light or light originating from celestial bodies. Headlight, however, refers to an artificial light source, typically found on vehicles.
